candidate: 1.2 s desired time headway, selected on US 101

coverage_failure.i294_l1: Only runs 8, 11 and 18 can supply a continuous 20 s small vehicle track at or below 16 m/s after excluding flagged automation. Three runs cannot meet the six run rule even before screening the lead vehicle and lane.
coverage_failure.i294_l2: The necessary low speed vehicle filter returns 30 samples in one track. It cannot supply a 20 s window.

external_selection: Use at most 24 reproducibly selected ordinary vehicle tracks across eligible acquisition runs. Balance the number of tracks across available runs where the cohort permits. Require one 20 s window per track, the same lane and leader throughout, 16 m/s maximum, valid lane projection and no flagged automation in either vehicle. Keep road and capture run identities separate.
decision_constraints: Vehicle, controller settings, headway, two common test seeds, metrics, run weighting and acceptance rules remain as published. A cohort with fewer than 24 tracks or six acquisition runs can be evaluated descriptively and cannot be accepted.
